name: NEURA 4NE1 Gen 3.5
summary: A 1.80 m, 80 kg German bipedal humanoid with two 12-DoF hands, offered for reservation with delivery expected at the end of 2026.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany. NEURA takes refundable 100 EUR reservations; the maker says 4NE1 Gen 3.5 is expected to be available at the end of 2026. Schaeffler signed a large humanoid order in November 2025, but no delivered units to customers were found.

priceEur.note: Estimated price per unit for 1-19 units, excluding taxes and shipping; 60,000 EUR per unit for 20 or more units.

sellers.name: NEURA Robotics GmbH
sellers.note: Manufacturer in Metzingen, Germany. Online reservation for single units; commercial quantities through the contact form.

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: Datasheet says "Arms payload 20 kg"; not stated whether per arm or for both arms; application-dependent

specs.label: Operating time
specs.conditions: As stated on the datasheet; battery runtime per charge not given

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 360-degree perception, touch-sensitive sensor skin; human-detection safety sensors optional at extra cost

specs.label: Interfaces
specs.value: Wi-Fi 6, Ethernet, Python SDK, ROS 2, C++ SDK; digital twin, teleoperation

notes: Delivered with integrated high-dexterity hands, battery and charging station; third-party end effectors not included.
Arm payload of 20 kg is not specified as per arm or both arms.
Human-detection safety sensors are optional at extra cost.
NEURA also offers 4NE1 versions on wheels and with a 7th axis on request; no separate specs or prices published.
No IP rating, stair or outdoor capability published.

evidence.task: Humanoid robots for factory work at Schaeffler plants
evidence.note: Order reported at about 300 million EUR; Schaeffler also works with other humanoid makers. No task or deployment date given.
